parole.testo: From Old Swedish gaster, possibly borrowed from Old Frisian gāst, from Proto-West Germanic *gaist.

parole.significato: to clothe, to dress, to wear (clothes)
parole.testo: Apocopic form of kläda, from Old Frisian klath (“dress”).

parole.significato: a cart (usually two-wheeled carriage or wagon)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Swedish kärra, probably borrowed from Old Frisian [Term?], compare Middle Dutch kerre and Middle Low German karre, ultimately from Latin carrus. Doublet of horse and russ; related to karriär.
